items.body: Thanks for the report. This issue appears to concern the Blackbox Exporter rather than the Prometheus server itself. For best results, please raise this problem at https://github.com/prometheus/blackbox_exporter, where the maintainers of that component can assist you directly.

items.message: Decision: OTHER_PROJECT. Precheck: not maintainer-authored, mentions blackbox_exporter as another project, no missing template sections, no vulnerability or question signals. Duplicate search: no candidates. Label validator: component/scraping is valid, but per decision table, no label is emitted for OTHER_PROJECT. Emitted a comment directing the reporter to the Blackbox Exporter repository.
